segments.text: The home office deduction, done right. There are two ways to claim it, and they can give you very different numbers.

Say your office is three hundred square feet of a twenty-four hundred square foot home. The simplified method gives you fifteen hundred dollars. The regular method, twelve and a half percent of twenty-eight thousand, eight hundred dollars in home costs, gives you thirty-six hundred.
Next up: Section 179, and how to expense your equipment this year. Thanks for watching.
